ARKhives 8.19.10

- Fix the disappearing sidebar and top bar after leaving a lesson: queued editor/status updates can no longer reopen a closed or inactive lesson shell.
- Restrict immersive styling to an active lesson, so a stale layout flag cannot hide navigation on Dashboard or Study Library.
- Restore the original ARKhives brand artwork in the lesson header.
- Use the shared ARKhives colors and typography in the desktop lesson workspace. Keep capture actions separate from chapter navigation at narrower desktop widths.
- Simplify desktop page introductions and standardize tabs, notebook-card spacing and action alignment.
- Preserve the independent mobile interface, shared learning engine, question banks, notes and personal progress.

Validation includes the native/shared-engine suite, editor lifecycle regression tests, real bundled ONLYOFFICE navigation and DOCX-save checks, five lesson window widths including 826 px, and 39 desktop page/layout checks.
